description.en: The junior grading pathway of the British Judo Association: eighteen Mon grades from red to brown belt. Skills that are not single techniques (breakfalls, escapes, turnovers, grips, randori) are also available to review on the site.

source.title: BJA Junior Grading Programme, Mon Grade Syllabus Pictorial Guide

note.en: Transcribed from the official pictorial guide; item wording kept as printed. The guide predates the current IJF leg-grab rules, so some later grades include leg-grab techniques.

alt.en: BJA syllabus poster for 1st to 3rd Mon: breakfalls, Osoto-otoshi, Kesa-gatame, De-ashi-barai, Mune-gatame, Uki-goshi and Kuzure-kesa-gatame in step-by-step drawings.

alt.en: BJA syllabus poster for 4th to 6th Mon: forward breakfalls, Tai-otoshi, Yoko-shiho-gatame, Ippon-seoi-nage, Kami-shiho-gatame, O-uchi-gari and Tate-shiho-gatame in step-by-step drawings.

alt.en: BJA syllabus poster for 7th to 9th Mon: Ko-uchi-gari, Tsuri-komi-goshi, O-goshi, Ko-soto-gari, Ko-soto-gake, Morote-seoi-nage, Seoi-otoshi, O-soto-gari and combination work in step-by-step drawings.
